skill.name: nex-datasheet-extractor
skill.description: Extracts structured electrical specs, package data, and compliance status from component datasheet PDFs. Use when: Convert PDF datasheets into structured JSON or CSV rows; Identify electrical constraints like voltage and temperature ranges; Extract package and pin count data for footprint assignment.
skill.summary: Guides extraction of component specifications from text-based datasheets; executable extraction scripts are not included.
skill.author: nexaiguy

content.value_statement: Manual datasheet transcription makes component library updates slow and error-prone. This guide defines extraction targets and structured output expectations for an agent with suitable PDF tools.
actual_capabilities: Defines extraction targets for primary part numbers and manufacturer names.
Identifies supply voltage limits and operating temperature ranges as fields to collect.
Specifies package strings and pin counts for footprint mapping.
Directs attention to RoHS and REACH statements within datasheet text.
Describes JSON and CSV output for component libraries.
Provides an illustrative extraction result with a confidence label.
limitations: This package contains only SKILL.md; extraction scripts, tests, and templates are not included.
The documented workflow requires PDFs with selectable text; scanned pages and image-based tables are unsupported.
Electrical values require manual verification before component library updates.
Compliance extraction reflects document statements, not independent certification; the supplied guide implements no confidence scoring algorithm.

use_cases.title: Prepare ECAD library entries
use_cases.description: Use the guide to organize voltage, temperature, package, and pin count fields for review before importing component records.

use_cases.title: Collect documented compliance statements
use_cases.description: Record RoHS and REACH statements from supplier datasheets, distinguishing missing declarations from explicit compliance claims.

use_cases.title: Plan a searchable component dataset
use_cases.description: Use the documented fields to define consistent records for an internal component database and a separately implemented extraction workflow.

prompt_templates.title: Identify basic component details
prompt_templates.prompt: Using the supplied datasheet text, identify the part number, manufacturer, package, and pin count. Mark missing values as unknown.

prompt_templates.title: Review electrical limits
prompt_templates.prompt: Extract supply voltage and operating temperature limits from this datasheet text. Include units, conditions, and source sections. Separate operating limits from absolute maximum ratings.

prompt_templates.title: Prepare a library row
prompt_templates.prompt: Use available PDF tools to read this text-based datasheet and prepare a CSV row using the guide's fields. Flag unsupported values for manual review.
prompt_templates.scenario: Intermediate: prepare structured output with separately available tools.

prompt_templates.title: Plan batch extraction
prompt_templates.prompt: Plan batch extraction for these text-based datasheets using separately available tools. Specify CSV columns, unknown handling, compliance evidence, and manual checks. Identify missing dependencies before execution.
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced: design a repeatable extraction workflow.

output_examples.input: Illustrative review of the STM32F405RG fields shown in the guide.
output: Part number: STM32F405RG; manufacturer: STMicroelectronics; package: LQFP64.
Supply range: 1.8 to 3.6 V; operating temperature: -40 to 85 degrees Celsius.
The guide labels RoHS status compliant and confidence high; these example values still require verification against the actual datasheet.

output_examples.input: Review an illustrative datasheet excerpt that gives package and voltage data but contains no REACH declaration.
output: Package and voltage: record only the values explicitly stated in the supplied excerpt.
REACH status: unknown; no declaration found in the supplied excerpt.
Review status: verify the complete datasheet and supplier declarations before recording a compliance conclusion.

best_practices: Confirm that the PDF has selectable text and that suitable extraction tools are available.
Verify values, units, operating conditions, and package variants against the source datasheet.
Keep missing compliance statements unknown and review every record before library import.
anti_patterns: Assuming the public guide includes runnable extraction scripts or tests.
Treating absolute maximum ratings as normal operating limits.
Inferring compliance or accepting confidence labels without checking source evidence.

faq.question: Does this package include a working PDF extractor?
faq.answer: No. It contains a public guide only. Scripts, extension source, templates, and tests described elsewhere in the document are not included.

faq.question: Can it process scanned datasheets?
faq.answer: The documented workflow supports text-based PDFs only. Scanned pages and image-based tables require separate OCR tooling.

faq.question: Which fields does the guide cover?
faq.answer: It covers part numbers, manufacturers, supply voltages, operating temperatures, package strings, pin counts, and RoHS or REACH statements.

faq.question: Can I use it with Claude, Codex, or Claude Code?
faq.answer: The guide can inform these agents. Actual PDF processing requires separately available tools; the package supplies no executable integration.

faq.question: Does it certify component compliance?
faq.answer: No. It describes extracting compliance statements from documents. Missing declarations remain unknown, and supplier evidence requires review.

faq.question: Are exported records ready for direct library import?
faq.answer: The guide targets JSON or CSV records, but users must verify electrical values and adapt fields to their library requirements.
